zero_means: every call reads rate_limit fresh (the old behavior)
note: BH-8334. One process reuses its last good `gh api rate_limit` body for this many seconds in gh_budget_exhausted, gh_budget_ratelimit_alert and the fresh read of gh_budget_refresh (in-process memo _ghb_rl_read; shell variables, never the box cache file). A failed read is never kept. Resolved through lib_env_apply gh-budget at source time; code fallback 60, and a value that is not a non-negative integer is 60.
